Home / Our Impact

Responsible reporting

We are just beginning.

Ruang Tanpa Stigma began in 2026 with the aim of making conversations about HIV better informed, more human and freer from stigma. As the project develops, this page will report activities, reach, learning and evaluation findings transparently.

No results are being claimed yet

Planning targets are not achievements. Numbers and findings will appear only after real data has been collected, checked and given context.

It is better to have no number yet than to display a number without meaning.

What will be measured

Activity, quality, reach, engagement and learning.

Metrics will be used to understand the work and improve it—not to make the initiative appear larger than it is.

  • Content production

    Articles, videos, educational resources and content updates that are genuinely published.

  • Reach & engagement

    Website users, page views, social reach, clicks, saves and shares when data is available and definitions are clear.

  • Quality

    Source completeness, review dates, need for professional review, outdated pages and corrections.

  • Community activity

    Discussions, educational sessions, webinars or collaborations only when they actually occur.

  • Knowledge & attitudes

    Potential assessment of transmission knowledge, U=U understanding, resource usefulness and supportive attitudes—only after a sound method is prepared.

12-month framework

Four phases to build foundations before judging results.

  • Months 1–3 · Foundation

    Baseline, editorial standards, initial library, review process, content calendar and measurement system.

  • Months 4–6 · Reach & engagement

    Content distribution, format testing, aggregate measurement, common questions and feedback.

  • Months 7–9 · Community engagement

    Educational or collaborative activities may be tested when genuine opportunities and capacity exist.

  • Months 10–12 · Evaluation

    Summary of outputs, reach, quality, usefulness, limitations, lessons and an annual report.

Contribution, not over-attribution

Over time, the project seeks to contribute to HIV literacy, access to understandable education and more supportive conversations. Ruang Tanpa Stigma will not claim to be the sole cause of community-level change.

Reporting boundaries

What this page will not do.

  • Display zero counters that add no useful meaning.
  • Present targets as results.
  • Claim improved knowledge, reduced stigma, increased testing or better health without measurement.
  • Name partners, activities or reviewers that do not genuinely exist.
  • Collect sensitive health data merely to produce metrics.
